_comment: CH_ANIMATED_SPRITE_V1 — runtime contract for pre-rendered animated sprites with named behavior states.
description: Minimal animated sprite contract for city-builder props. Encodes named behavior states (IDLE, GREET, SERVE, ...) as frame ranges within a per-direction spritesheet. Designed for event-driven playback with long idle intervals.

policy.pivotPolicy: projected world origin fixed across directions and frames

idle.description: Canonical resting pose. 1 frame per direction is preferred.

greet.description: Short wave/greeting toward the street. Returns to idle base pose.
constraints: static cart and umbrella unless visual reason requires otherwise

serve.description: Serving/preparing interaction. Implement only after gameplay NPC interaction exists.
serve.implementWhen: gameplay has a real customer/NPC interaction that can trigger the behavior
constraints: one arm reaches toward product area
